name: fastbn
description: Bayesian network structure learning for omics data — network inference, edge stability, and visualization powered by FastBN

plugins.name: bn-analysis
plugins.description: Infer, score, bootstrap and visualize Bayesian networks from expression matrices (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell, proteomics) with the FastBN Hill-Climb + Tabu learner, and benchmark the result against a known network.
